def step_action(act, rep=1):
    ins = primitives.call(
        name="inspect_maniskill_instance",
        camera_uid="base_camera",
        segmentation_id=18,
        query="peg",
    )
    if not ins.ok:
        print("inspect err:", ins.error)
        return None
    ev = ins.output["evidence_id"]
    r = primitives.call(
        name="apply_maniskill_action",
        action=act,
        evidence_ids=[ev],
        repeat=rep,
    )
    if not r.ok:
        print("action err:", r.error)
    return primitives.call(name="observe_maniskill_control_state").output

def step_action_any(act, rep=1):
    ins = primitives.call(
        name="inspect_maniskill_instance",
        camera_uid="base_camera",
        segmentation_id=18,
        query="peg",
    )
    if not ins.ok:
        ins = primitives.call(
            name="inspect_maniskill_instance",
            camera_uid="base_camera",
            segmentation_id=16,
            query="table_place",
        )
    ev = ins.output["evidence_id"]
    r = primitives.call(
        name="apply_maniskill_action",
        action=act,
        evidence_ids=[ev],
        repeat=rep,
    )
    if not r.ok:
        print("action err:", r.error)
